spans.text: Earlier that day.
Galatea Sanatorium.
In Leone's ward, the television is showing the news coverage of a terrorist attack on Galatea's medical storage facility somewhere on the outskirts of Berlin that occurred yesterday.
The facility has been reduced to ashes, and all fruits of their research stored within have gone up in smoke...
...You actually went and did it.
I've warned you.
Staring at the vial Ange has placed on the table, Leone grips at the armrest of her chair anxiously with her uninjured hand.
I just want you to understand...
Not only do I have what it takes to throw down the gauntlet to Gray...
I did it, and I lived to tell the tale.
I am capable of offering you protection.
...I've told you before—I want no part in this anymore.
Say that to those who have died because of your research.
After all you've done, now you say, "I washed my hands of this business so please leave me alone"?
Do you really think the world is so simple?
You jumped into this whirlpool. You made that choice yourself.
Getting out is not an option. Either choose a side or be ripped apart by the whirlpool.
Think carefully.
...Why should I pick your side?
Don't forget, I'm in this sorry state all because of you.
Leone wriggles the shoulder that is still in a cast and snickers—either in contempt or in self-pity.
I give you the same answer—you have no other option.
Do you really think Gray is a good collaborator?
Ange rolls the vial over to reveal Galatea's logo.
We are the only ones who can protect you. If that still doesn't compute...
Just think about this—in Bremen, who was it that tossed you aside like a pawn?
Your injuries were my subordinate's doing, but don't you remember who put you in that situation in the first place?
Leone stares at the logo... She can almost hear RPK-16's devilish murmur again.
She deliberately cornered you and forced you to hand over your research.
She has been using you the whole time! And you're still counting on her to save your life?
Surely even an idiot can tell she's bad news!
Ange points at the television, which is still reporting the incident at the storage facility.
...H-How are you going to protect me?
The Stasi is standing right outside the door. One nod from you...
And I can mobilize the strongest armed force of this country to give you personal protection.
...I could have killed you in Bremen, but I didn't. You know I am a woman of my word.
Beads of sweat form on Leone's forehead. It is obvious that she is deep in internal conflict.
After a while, she finally looks up, having come to a decision.
What do you want to know?
...Your research—what exactly is it about?
What is Gray after? What is she doing?
My research is very simple... The special substance known as the Collapse particle has a fascinating relationship with plants.
As a kind of vessel, the Epiphyllum can absorb Collapse Particles, then it erupts and discharges them after a cycle.
During this cycle, the Collapse Particles in these loaded Epiphylla cannot be detected—at least there is no existing technology that can detect them.
My job is to test what external factors affect the latency of the Epiphyllum's eruption. In other words, to make it possible to control when a loaded Epiphyllum erupts.
So...So basically, you can deliver Epiphylla loaded with Collapse Particles anywhere?
A chill runs down Ange's spine.
This is what Gray is after? She's planning an Epiphyllum eruption somewhere?
How do terrorist attacks and destroying the city benefit her?
She isn't doing this just for the sake of destruction, obviously!
Her aim is to release Collapse Particles in small areas to increase the number of ELID cases.
Then by launching a cure, she will gain the people's support...and they will rely even more on her.
I don't know what her ultimate goal is, but her plan is working.
I see...
Sooner or later, she'll cause a riot by orchestrating a large-scale attack, and Rossartre's plans in Germany will go down the drain...
Way to go, William.
I never took part in her operation.
But I know of a few locations. She had me send my creations to those places.
They're all in Berlin.
I know nothing about the details, but I can give you a list so you'll know where she's planning to carry out her plan.
...No, there's no time.
Gray is in such a hurry to get rid of me because her plan is reaching a critical stage.
She could begin anytime!
But this is really all I know!
That's okay... I can always just pay her a visit.
What...?!
Are you crazy?!
It's worth a shot.
Ange stands up with her fists clenched.
Then as she suddenly remembers something, she rummages through her pockets and fishes out a name card.
...Besides, she invited me herself.
...Do you really promise you'll keep me safe?
Leone looks at Ange, apprehension written all over her face.
Don't worry.
Ange stuffs Gray's card back into her pocket.
I promise.
